便宜.s: 我多买一些，可以便宜点吗？
便宜.p: Wǒ duō mǎi yìxiē, kěyǐ biànyí diǎn ma?
便宜.e: If I buy more, can I get them cheaper?

对不起.p: Duìbùqǐ, shì wǒ gūfù nǐ le.
对不起.e: I am sorry for disappointing you.

水果.e: What fruit do you like the best?

星期.e: We're having a barbeque on Sunday.

读书.p: Dúshū shì rénshēng yí dà kuài shì.
读书.e: Reading is one of life's great pleasures.

妹妹.e: My sister is cooking in the kitchen.

中学.p: Tā zài yì suǒ zhōngxué gōngzuò.
中学.e: He works in a secondary school.

牛奶.p: Zhè niúnǎi yǒu tèshū de qìwèi.
牛奶.e: This milk has a peculiar smell.

你好.p: Wǒ huì gěi diǎn nǐhǎo dōngxī.

中文.e: I am very interested in learning Chinese.

哪些.e: Which credit cards can I use?

出租车.e: Excuse me, where is the taxi stand?

下班.p: Wǒ jīntiān néng zǎodiǎn xiàbān ma?
下班.e: Would it be OK if I left work early today?

白天.e: He sleeps during the day and works at night.

开车.p: Wǒ huì jiào nǐ zěnme kāichē.
开车.e: I'll teach you how to drive a car.

上学.p: Tā yǐjīng wǔ tiān bú shàngxué le.
上学.e: She's been absent from school for five days.

鸡蛋.e: How would you like your eggs?

弟弟.p: Wǒ xīwàng nǐ dìdi hǎo diǎn le.
弟弟.e: I hope that your brother is better.

女士.p: Nàbian de liǎng wèi nǚshì shì shéi?
女士.e: Who are the two women over there?

好听.e: My sister sings songs very well.

那边.p: Dào nàbian xūyào duō cháng shíjiān?
那边.e: How long will it take to get there?

再见.e: I'm glad to see you back.

饭店.p: Wǒmen de fàndiàn shì zuìhǎo de.

小朋友.s: 做个讨人喜欢的小朋友。

下雨.p: Wǒ shuō le kěnéng yào xiàyǔ.

这边.p: Nǐ bùnéng zài zhù zài zhèbiān le.
这边.e: You can't live on this side anymore.

这儿.p: Nǐ dàodǐ zài zhèr zuò shénme?

女朋友.s: 我知道你们都有女朋友。
女朋友.p: Wǒ zhīdào nǐmen dōu yǒu nǚpéngyou.
女朋友.e: I know you all have girlfriends.

商店.p: Jìn shāngdiàn de rén shì wǒ mèimei.
商店.e: The person entering the store is my younger sister.

男朋友.p: Tā de nánpéngyou shì gè bèndàn.

汉语.s: 这是我们汉语老师的车。
汉语.p: Zhè shì wǒmen Hànyǔ lǎoshī de chē.
汉语.e: This is our Chinese language teacher's car.

桌子.p: Zhuōzi shàng de shū shì shéi de?
桌子.e: Whose book is this on the desk?

晚饭.p: Wǒ xiǎng qù fàndiàn chī wǎnfàn.
晚饭.e: I wanna have dinner in a restaurant.

生病.p: Tā yí kàn jiùshì shēngbìng le de.

面包.p: Nǐ wǔfàn xiǎng chī miànbāo ma?
面包.e: Would you like to eat a roll for lunch?

看病.e: The doctor was giving a patient a checkup.

那儿.p: Nǐ quèdìng nǐ yào qù nàr ma?
那儿.e: Are you sure that you want to go there?

椅子.p: Nǐ de yǐzi hé wǒ de hěn xiàng.
椅子.e: Your chair is similar to mine.

做饭.s: 她喜欢为她的家人做饭。
做饭.p: Tā xǐhuan wèi tā de jiārén zuòfàn.
做饭.e: She likes cooking for her family.

饺子.s: 晚上我们去吃饺子，好吗？
饺子.p: Wǎnshang wǒmen qù chī jiǎozi, hǎo ma?
饺子.e: We're going out for dumplings in the evening, all right?

书店.e: There is a bookstore in front of the department store.

中学生.s: 过去,我是中学生,现在我是大学生.
中学生.p: Guòqù, wǒ shì zhōngxuéshēng, xiànzài wǒ shì dàxuéshēng.
中学生.e: In the past, I was a middle school student. Now I am a college student.

午饭.e: What are you eating for lunch?

下课.s: 他们四十分钟之后下课。
下课.e: They'll get out of class in forty minutes.

电影院.s: 你今天晚上去电影院吗？
电影院.p: Nǐ jīntiān wǎnshang qù diànyǐngyuàn ma?
电影院.e: Will you go to the cinema tonight?

早饭.s: 我穿好衣服，然后吃早饭。
早饭.p: Wǒ chuān hǎo yīfu, ránhòu chī zǎofàn.
早饭.e: I'm getting dressed, after which I will take my breakfast.

汉字.p: Tā hànzì xiě de fēicháng hǎo.
汉字.e: He writes Chinese characters very well.

星期天.p: Nǐ de zài Xīngqītiān gōngzuò ma?
星期天.e: Do you need to work on Sundays?

米饭.p: Zài nǐmen guójiā chī mǐfàn ma?
米饭.e: Do you eat rice in your country?

一点儿.p: Suǒyǐ, yìdiǎnr yě bú rè ne.
一点儿.e: So, it isn't hot at all.

星期日.e: We are against working on Sundays.

外边.e: The wind is really strong outside.

不客气.s: 你要是再给我们公司出洋相，我可就不客气了。
不客气.p: Nǐ yàoshi zài gěi wǒmen gōngsī chūyángxiàng, wǒ kějiù búkèqi le.
不客气.e: If you make fun of our company again, we certainly won’t be polite to you.

八.s: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十。
八.p: Yí, èr, sān, sì, wǔ, liù, qī, bā, jiǔ, shí.
八.e: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

百.s: 我的学校里有一百个人。
百.p: Wǒ de xuéxiào lǐ yǒu yì bǎi gèrén.
百.e: There are one hundred people in my school.

点.p: Tā zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng de.
点.e: She got up at seven in the morning.

多.p: Wǒmen kěyǐ yǒu duō xiāngxìn tā?
多.e: To what degree can we trust him?

二.p: Tā shì gè èr niánjí xuésheng.
二.e: She is a second year student.

九.s: 明天九点打电话给我吧。
九.p: Míngtiān jiǔ diǎn dǎdiànhuà gěi wǒ ba.

零.p: Jīnnián shì èr líng yìyì nián.

六.p: Bólǎnhuì jiàng jǔxíng liù gè yuè.
六.e: The exposition will be held for six months.

千.p: Tā yǒu yì qiān duō běn shū.
千.e: He has more than a thousand books.

三.p: Wǒmen sān gè dōu shì xuésheng.
三.e: All three of us are students.

十.s: 我在中国学习了十个月了。
十.p: Wǒ zài Zhōngguó xuéxí le shí gè yuè le.
十.e: I've been studying in China for ten months.

手机.p: Nín de shǒujī hàomǎ shì duōshǎo?

四.p: Tāmen jiéhūn yǐjīng sì nián le.
四.e: They have been married for four years.

五.p: Wǒmen jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
五.e: Our family consists of five members.

一.p: Nǐ jīntiān kěyǐ xiūjià yì tiān.
